key_stat: Central bank of central banks | BIS Innovation Hub | Project mBridge, Agora, Mariana
summary: The Bank for International Settlements (BIS) is the 'central bank of central banks' serving 63 central banks. The BIS Innovation Hub runs cutting-edge fintech experiments: Project mBridge (multi-CBDC platform), Project Agora (tokenised cross-border payments with 7 central banks + 41 private firms), Project Mariana (DeFi for FX). BIS also sets regulatory standards (Basel Committee) and provides banking services to central banks. Technology procurement for internal systems and Innovation Hub projects.
